system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Ask about the latest cricket match scores and player statistics.

function.name: pmfby_track_grievance_status
function.description: Tracks the status of a previously raised PMFBY grievance. Returns resolution status, assigned officer, and remarks. Requires session_token. This tool does NOT raise new grievances. Fails if grievance_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: pmfby_generate_otp
function.description: Sends OTP to the mobile number linked with the farmer's Aadhaar for PMFBY authentication. This is the first step in the authentication flow. It does NOT verify the OTP or create a session. Fails if Aadhaar is not 12 digits or mobile number is not registered with Aadhaar.
